name: semantic_recall
description: Semantic search using AI embeddings - finds memories by MEANING, not just keywords. Use this for NATURAL LANGUAGE QUESTIONS (multiple words, sentence structure). Examples: understands 'spouse' = 'wife', 'born' = 'birthday', 'celebrate' = 'birthday'. If query is a simple keyword (1-2 words), use search_memory instead. More powerful but slower than keyword search.

query.description: Natural language search query - can be a question or topic

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return
